Name: Casks on Ground
Author: yakminepunyo
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=4]Casks on Ground(CoG)

[b][color=#ffffff][size=3][OVERVIEW][/size][/color][/b][size=3]
[color=rgb(97, 97, 97)][color=#000000][color=#ffffff] ﻿This mod let casks work even outside of the cellar.

[b][INSTALLATION INSTRUCTION]
[/b][/color][/color][/color][/size][/size][/color][list=1]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have installed [b]StardewValley 1.3 [/b][/size][b]and SMAPI 2.6+.[/b]
[*][size=3]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract "CasksOnGround" folder inside of the zip file to "Mods" folder. (structure will be like: Mods/CasksOnGround/...)[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game and you should get effect of this mod.[/size]
[/list]
[b][SOURCE CODE]
﻿[/b]You can see codes from [url=https://github.com/pomepome/CasksOnGround]GitHub[/url].
